countries.reasoning: China is the largest producer based on industry reports and chemical production statistics from 2022-2023; data is recent and consistent with known chemical manufacturing capacity.
The US has significant production capacity and well-documented chemical industry statistics; data from American Chemistry Council and USGS chemical production review 2023.
Germany is a major European producer with reliable sources from chemical industry reports and European chemical associations (data circa 2022).
India's growing chemical industry and documented production expansions contribute to this estimate; data is slightly older but adjusted with trade data.
South Korea is a noted producer in East Asia; production data is less detailed but supported by trade and industry reports from 2021-2023.
